conditions: Only one adversary at a time: clear or convert any active Kuva Lich, Sister or Technocyte Coda first.
Ergo Glast never sells the Diplos; his Corrupted Holokey shop only carries Tenet melee and the Tenet Ferrox. Every ranged Tenet weapon comes from a Sister.

groups.activity: clear the Nightmare Granum Void; inspect Candidates

rows.label: Tenet Diplos Candidate
rows.note: Mercy only when the weapon preview says Diplos
rows.alt: buy a converted Tenet Diplos Sister

rows.label: progenitor element
rows.note: sets the bonus element (25-60%) and any Ephemera's element (20% chance)
rows.alt: Elemental Vice can change it later at rank 40

conditions: A Treasurer spawns 2-5 minutes into any non-endless Corpus Ship mission and drops a Crown tiered by level; level 31+ or Steel Path drops the Zenith, the only tier that spawns a Candidate. Hydra's 30-34 range makes the Treasurer's Crown refund near-certain.
Don't open the Tribute within about 200m of extraction; it can suppress the Candidate spawn entirely.
If the preview isn't Diplos, leave her and complete and extract from the mission. Aborting does not remove that weapon from the pool; only a completed rejection does.

The Sister-carried pool is 11 weapons (Arca Plasmor, Cycron, Detron, Diplos, Envoy, Flux Rifle, Glaxion, Plinx, Quanta, Spirex, Tetra), so correctly rejecting guarantees Diplos inside 11 completed missions.
Only the player who dealt the final hit can Mercy, and a Rank 4+ Sister spawns Spectralysts: exact copies of your Warframe and loadout.
bonuses: A 0-Forma Xoris heavy attack, or a wide-AoE frame like Uriel or Octavia, clears the Granum Void fast; summoning your Railjack On Call specter as you're pulled in also helps.
Run solo: a bigger squad raises the kill requirement, not the spawn rate, and you still get only one Candidate.

groups.activity: Mercy Hounds, reveal Requiems, test the sequence
groups.meta: ~180 Murmurs; ~2 missions per Sister to spawn
groups.mode: long missions first, then fast ones
conditions: Requiem mods come from the single Requiem Eterna relic (all 8 mods at equal chance), from Kuva Siphon (50%) or Kuva Flood (100%). Hounds also drop one 5% of the time.
Up to 3 Hounds spawn per mission on a cooldown of about 1m20s; kill the Sister's own summoned Hound before downing her, since it self-destructs.
Failing a Parazon attempt levels the Sister up, raising every node she controls.
bonuses: Survival, Defense and Excavation on her nodes maximize Hounds per mission; switch to Capture or Exterminate once you only need rage to draw her out.

disclosures.title: Oull-first Parazon
disclosures.body: Put Oull in slot 1 and test your first known Requiem in slot 2. You'll usually solve the order in about 4 stabs or fewer, and each stab still brings a fresh Hound. Oull comes from Sisters, not relics, and reports differ on whether it drops from a failed stab or only at 25% once the sequence succeeds: expect to have none for your first Sister.

rows.label: Tenet Diplos
rows.note: built; Foundry delivery, her Hound fully built too

conditions: Choose Vanquish, never Convert: Convert gives an ally and a tradeable Sister token but no weapon.
Your active Sister taxes Credits on the nodes she controls, growing with the number of nodes; you get it all back when you beat her.
Needs Railjack Intrinsics rank 3; bring a Railjack with real hull and shield mods, or run it in a squad if yours is weak.
bonuses: A squad also earns up to 4 Corrupted Holokeys instead of 1, though those buy Tenet melees, not the Diplos.

conditions: Fusion takes the higher of the two bonuses x 1.1, capped at 60%.
Fuse into the copy you've invested in: the donor's Catalyst, Forma, Exilus adapter and Elemental Vice are all destroyed.

disclosures.title: the aiming complaint
disclosures.body: The long-running gripe, since 2021, is that aiming forces lock-on mode instead of free aim. It reportedly grows on you with Secondary Dexterity and an electric build, where lock-on works as a crowd tool. A June 2026 poll (463 votes) was lukewarm, with 'never used it' the largest group and 'good weapon' tied with 'meh'.
